name: Geppi Cucciari
bio: Geppi Cucciari (born Maria Giuseppina Cucciari; 18 August 1973) is an Italian comedian, actress, radio and television presenter. She began her career in stand-up and cabaret with Zelig Off and Zelig Circus, later gaining national prominence on Italian television with a range of hosting and acting roles. Cucciari has presented numerous programmes (including Un giorno da pecora on Rai Radio 1 and cultural and entertainment shows on Rai 3) and appeared in TV series and films such as Belli dentro, Romeo è Giulietta and Diamanti. She has also hosted major events including the Premio Strega ceremonies and co-hosted a night of the Sanremo Music Festival.
